documents.text:
# Setup
Install dependencies before starting the local server.

# Authorization
Only note owners may delete notes. Database delete operations do not check ownership.

# SQL queries
User input in SQL queries must use parameterized placeholders, never string concatenation.

# Pricing
Total price equals unit price multiplied by quantity. Inputs are validated finite numbers.
